name: signature-pad
title: Signature pad
description: Sign on the screen. One brush pen with real pressure, a pencil baseline with its x, a clear button, and a typed-name fallback that is set in hand lettering. It carries the image in a hidden field, so it works in a plain form and can be required.

a11y: The canvas is a named application ("Signature"); the same keyboard drawing as Sketchpad works: arrows move a cursor, Space puts the pen down and lifts it. Typing the name is the accessible alternative and is one button away.
Type mode replaces the canvas by an image named "Signature, typed: Ada Lovelace" and a text field labeled "Type your full name".

Required: a visually hidden text input holds the value so the browser's own validation and message apply; the failure also shows a role="alert" line and moves focus to the canvas (the name field in type mode).
The baseline turns red pencil when invalid, and the message says why (color is never the only cue).
Windows high contrast keeps the ink colors of the strokes; the sheet gets a real border.
